name: nft-ct-ct-new-drop-sub-returns
description: ct-new-drop with a chain that returns before its own drop
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub return
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ct state new drop
